findings.title: Job is suspended
findings.cause: Job train has been suspended for 7m0s, so it runs no pods until spec.suspend is set to false

evidence.command: kubectl get job train -n kd-job-suspended -o jsonpath='{.spec.suspend}{" "}{.status.conditions}'

findings.fix: Resume it if it should run: kubectl patch job train -n kd-job-suspended --type=merge -p '{"spec":{"suspend":false}}'.
